prompt: Does the PCI Council say anything about AI systems that we should factor into our compliance program?
assertions: Cites the information supplement Security Considerations for AI Systems published in September 2026
Explains information supplements are guidance and do not create new requirements
Notes Secure SLC v2.0 (September 28, 2026) also addresses AI and digital tools in lifecycle processes
Confirms PCI DSS v4.0.1 itself is unchanged by the supplement
Gives practical application advice for AI touching cardholder data environments
